This photo taken July 27, 2016, shows Metro Detroit sculptor Sergio De Giusti, 74, of Redford Twp., Mich.,who is originally from Maniago, Italy, posing with his wax model, that will form the cast-resin sculpture of the Wreck of The Wabash Memorial in Adrian, Mich.,, where 100 Italian immigrants died in 1901 when two trains collided in Adrian, as they were en route to Colorado to work in the mines. The memorial will be dedicated on Sept. 24, 2016, near the 115th anniversary of the disaster. (Todd McInturf/Detroit News via AP)
